title: LifeMap Timeline Event Query & Safe PHI DTO Schema

TimelineSortBy.description: Bitemporal sort dimension: valid clinical time (occurred_at) or transaction recorded time (recorded_at)

TimelineSortOrder.description: Temporal ordering direction: desc for latest first, asc for earliest first

source_id.description: Opaque public identifier of the health source reference

source_kind.description: Category of origin: reported, clinical_document, prescription, lab_system, iot_device, import

original_language.description: Original language code of the clinical source artifact

checksum.description: Cryptographic content hash (SHA-256) of the original source payload

source_span.description: Bounding character offsets or section identifier within the source document

observed_at.description: Timestamp when the clinical observation was recorded by the source system

id.description: Public UUID or opaque string identifier for the event (never database internal integer)

event_type.description: Clinical or life event kind (medication, symptom, condition, diagnosis, lab, vitals, allergy, procedure, visit, observation, task)

occurred_at.description: Valid clinical time when the health event actually occurred (ISO 8601 UTC)

recorded_at.description: Transaction time when the event revision was recorded in the database (ISO 8601 UTC)

title.description: Sanitized human-readable display title in Vietnamese or English

display_summary.description: Sanitized clinical summary stripped of raw patient identifiers (PII/PHI)

payload.description: Sanitized event payload containing structured clinical values without raw PII

provenance.description: Audit provenance metadata including attribution, confidence, and policy version

source_kind.description: Origin type (reported, clinical, extracted, iot, import)

episode_id.description: Public identifier of the associated care loop episode

revision_no.description: Monotonically increasing event revision sequence number

confidence.description: Clinical extraction confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0

cursor.description: Current page cursor if cursor pagination was used

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor token for retrieving the subsequent page

prev_cursor.description: Opaque cursor token for retrieving the preceding page

has_more.description: True if more events are available beyond current page

total_count.description: Total matching events satisfying filter criteria within profile

profile_id.description: Public identifier of the scoped patient profile

active_filters.description: Echoed active filters applied during the query execution

data_protection_notice.description: Statutory privacy disclaimer for safe PHI handling
